tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The stable bivalency of $\mathrm{Pb}$ and trivalency of $\mathrm{Bi}$ is

options.text: due to relativistic contraction of the $6 s$ orbitals of $\mathrm{Pb}$ and $\mathrm{Bi}$, leading to inert pair effect
due to attainment of noble liquid configuration

solution.text:
$_{82} \mathrm{Pb}=6 \mathrm{s}^{2} 6 p^{2}$
$_{83}{\mathrm{Bi}}=6 s^{2} 6 p^{3}$
Due to inertness of $6 s^{2}$ electrons in $\mathrm{Pb}$ and $\mathrm{Bi}$, they show bivalency and trivalency respectively instead of tetra and pentavalency.
